yamlCheck.dateAnchor: November 20 is independently spoken for Havdar’s cure. The year and current reunion date come from YAML; fourth-day and four-day travel anchors fit November 15–23. The opening forest examinations are explicitly earlier but have no spoken adventure dates.
yamlCheck.explanation: The current reunited-party track supports eight calendar transitions conditional on YAML’s start. The earlier played forest examinations leave the overall start boundary open; historical events shown within their visions do not extend adventure time. Retrospective scries, the November 20 scenes and yesterday’s Commune are nested, not added days.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: Whether the metadata span describes only the resumed reunion journey or all played retrospective examinations remains unresolved.

alternatives.reading: Current reunited-party journey starts on the YAML date.
Including the earlier forest examinations moves the covered beginning earlier; the current transcript supplies no exact date.
